[[Sunreach Warmaker]] is a [[Warden]] [[boss]] that can be encountered in the [[Morostav Trail]] [[explorable area]].

== Notes ==
* Be careful when fighting him, as he is accompanied by several groups of enemies. These groups, however, can be pulled away from his own group.
* He is also located near [[Falaharn Mistwarden]], who will [[spawn]] if you go far enough into the area.
